sloka: अनेन तु नृशंसेन रावणेनाधमेन मे ।समयो यस्तु निर्दिष्टस्तस्य कालो ऽयमागतः ।। ५.२६.३४।।।।
transliteration: anena tu nṛśaṁsena rāvaṇenādhamena me ।samayo yastu nirdiṣṭastasya kālo 'yamāgataḥ ।। 5.26.34।।।।

translations.english: "If the heroic Rama of bloodshot eyes comes to know that I am here at Ravana's, the expiry of time limit fixed by this cruel, lowly, foolish Ravana has arrived, this wicked fellow's death is inevitable.
